reviews.title: I’ve played since 2016 this is still peak
reviews.text: This is one of the most entertaining games for people with ADHD out there. You can choose what you want to do if you want to focus on the story go ahead if you want to play competitively that’s fine. Unlike in other games it is low pressure and has a cozy vibe making it perfect for slow days. I have made 3 accounts starting from nothing and I am f2p. It has been fun and entertaining and is something I even play with my younger cousins and siblings so it is fun to play with all ages. The community of this game in particular is nave and very welcoming to new players!

reviews.title: Amazing Game

reviews.title: Might be sayonara…
reviews.text: I’m back again, but this might be the last time i play… The new update seemed to make the game a bit smoother, and i was surprised when i was able to do some trials, and events with no problems. Then it started again. In the middle of doing an event? Crash. Trial? Crash. Trophy race results? Crash. Trying to re-open the game? Immediate crash. A few times during an event (the new marine soda one) it would freeze, but 15 to 20 seconds later, it would be fine. Obstacles were turned into a random “x”, but i could still run. But then guess what? CRASH. I might end up having to delete the game flat out if it’s not fixed… i’ve been playing for years. Since the game was released, and have enjoyed it, but the constant crashing is becoming too much… i have the last newest ipad, and update, so I don’t know why it’s doing this…

reviews.title: Purchases are totally optional
reviews.text:
I love this game. I play it as often as I can and I’ve been playing for a couple years. I have all the cookies and it’s still super fun to play because they’re constantly adding and updating. 

Another thing that captured me immediately was the rewards for playing. Some games you play and they almost force you to pay real money to advance past a certain point. Not this game though. They reward constantly and I’m always buying up all the stuff I want in the shops which is so fun.   I love the events, especially the drawing ones that give prizes like costumes, cookies, potions, etc. I really can’t resist. Also, because they don’t force it, I spend money happily on this game when I really want something. I don’t mind spending a couple bucks on gameplay, as long as it’s my choice and not required to have fun.
